_comment: Layer 0. Store-wide metrics from ShopifyQL, for the overview at the top of the dashboard. Queries are config, not code: adding or changing a metric is an edit here, never a deploy of new logic.
_VERIFIED: Query syntax and response shape validated against the live First Day store on 2026-09-10. ShopifyQL is read-only aggregated reporting.

queries.sales: FROM sales SHOW orders, gross_sales, discounts, net_sales, total_sales, average_order_value SINCE -1d UNTIL today COMPARE TO previous_period
queries.sessions: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_that_completed_checkout, conversion_rate SINCE -1d UNTIL today COMPARE TO previous_period
queries.customers: FROM sales SHOW customers, new_customers, returning_customers, returning_customer_rate SINCE -1d UNTIL today COMPARE TO previous_period
queries._comment: SINCE -1d UNTIL today is yesterday plus today so far. COMPARE TO previous_period adds a comparison_<metric>__previous_period column for each metric, which is where the day over day arrow comes from. Every query must stay read-only: FROM ... SHOW, never a mutation.

alerts._comment: A tile moving more than this against the previous period is flagged in the readout. Kept deliberately blunt: this is a sanity check that the store has not moved under a test, not a statistical claim. Layer 3 owns the statistics.
